subtitle: Combinations built only from selections that have value.

empty.never: We never pad a parlay with selections that have no value.

value.title: Value filter on every selection
value.qualified: Qualified selection: its model has beaten the market
value.ev: Positive expected value at the current price
value.interval: A probability without a measured interval is left out

independence.title: No related selections
independence.independent: That is why they are treated as independent

noPadding.title: No padding
noPadding.body: If there are not enough selections with value, we show no parlay: we never pad.

choice.title: How they are chosen
choice.growth: By expected growth at each selection's cautious probability (the low end of the model's interval)
choice.positive: Built only if that growth is positive, and each added selection has to raise it
choice.frozen: Frozen once built: prices and probabilities do not change afterwards, and it is followed to its result

own.title: Rather build your own?
own.body: Add selections from matches or picks: we check the rules and keep it in My picks.
